title: Product Manager, Toll.OS (Tolling, ITMS and ATMS)_MPIN
description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

 **Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

description:

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

Identity is the new security perimeter, and JumpCloud’s Access & Authentication team owns it.

With remote work and the domainless enterprise here to stay, every login is now a security decision. Our products decide who gets access to what across devices, SSO apps, servers, RADIUS and LDAP. They power MFA, passwordless, and Zero Trust conditional access built on identity, location, risk, and certificate-based device trust.

As a Senior PM, you’ll define how millions of users prove who they are. You’ll balance two customers: IT admins who need control, and users who just want to get to work. description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), which includes Multichannel Commerce Fulfillment (MCCF), lets merchants use Amazon’s fulfilment and logistics network to reach customers wherever they shop: their own websites, social commerce, other marketplaces and wholesale. Our vision is to enable every entrepreneur in the world to reach every customer in the world through every channel they can imagine. Through Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), Buy with Prime (BwP), Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD) and Warehousing & Logistics, merchants keep products in stock, ship faster and more reliably, and lower their costs. For over 20 years Amazon has helped small and medium-sized businesses grow on Amazon; ASCS is how we help merchants of every size grow beyond it.  
  
As ASCS scales, how merchants find, choose and get more out of it matters as much as what it offers. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager–Technical (Sr. PMT) to shape how ASCS grows with merchants: understanding why merchants who would benefit are not yet using our services, building the products and platforms that change that, and proving what actually moves the business. You will pair strategic vision with hands-on execution, working across engineering, business, finance and data science teams to build products fundamental to Amazon’s future.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
> Product strategy & direction: Continuously assess the needs of our customers and partners in defining and evolving the product and business strategy. Identify where ASCS services create the most value for merchants and translate those insights into a clear, differentiated product direction across marketing and pricing surfaces.  
> Roadmap planning: Deliver world-class innovation in features, usability, and performance in a consistent release cadence. Be the internal and external authority for your program, driving value-based prioritisation from concept to launch to maximise ROI.  
> Requirements definition: Develop comprehensive product plans incorporating merchant needs, competitive context, and business objectives. Produce high-quality requirements docs and manage scope to deliver key capabilities on time.  
> Technical collaboration: Partner with engineering to craft BRDs, influence the design and architecture of technical solutions, and make informed trade-off decisions that balance merchant impact with implementation complexity.  
> AI & productivity leverage: Apply AI tools to meaningfully accelerate product development from drafting and iterating on requirement document, merchant-facing messaging, to customer research, modelling pricing scenarios, and generating campaign briefs. You will actively identify where AI can compress timelines and improve output quality across the product lifecycle, and serve as a proponent of AI adoption within your cross-functional teams.  
  
A day in the life  
> Collaborate with GTM, Sales, User Research, Tech, Finance, and Operations to define strategy, vision, and features for MCF and ASCS adoption.  
> Own the product backlog and BRDs across marketing and pricing workstreams; prioritize and make feature trade-offs that maximize merchant adoption and ROI.  
> Deliver products end-to-end across Engineering, Legal, Information Security, UX, and Finance from concept through launch.  
> Design, launch, and iterate on lifecycle automation and targeted campaigns to engage and convert unmanaged merchants at scale.  
> Communicate charter vision, roadmap, and business impact to senior leadership  
  
About the team  
  
ASCS helps merchants of every size reach customers on any channel through Multi-Channel Fulfillment, Buy with Prime, Multi-Channel Distribution and Warehousing & Logistics. The ASCS Monetisation team owns how this business earns while keeping merchants’ trust. We set what merchants pay through rate cards, fees, discounts, incentives and negotiated pricing. We make merchants whole when inventory or orders are lost, damaged or returned. And we decide how merchants are invoiced and collected from, extending flexible payment terms without avoidable bad debt. Every decision must be calculated correctly, posted accurately, explained clearly and measured for real impact.

* 6+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Product Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is passionate about building digital products which customers love. You will join a dynamic and fast-paced environment and work with cross-functional teams to design, build and roll-out products that deliver the company’s vision and strategy.
  
  
You are currently working on a flexible work arrangement and you are interested to take on more work which can be fulfilling and eventually convert into a rewarding full-time role.
  
  
Absolutely critical is your past experience in managing & understanding the engineering time taken to develop many features and then breaking that into multiple daily sprint batches. We use agile methodology and there are no sprints which last more than 2 weeks with testing time included.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
  
  

* We are looking for someone who can work across the entire product development cycle; customer research, UX discovery, hypothesis definition, wireframing, sprint planning, project management and product marketing.
* 3+ years of experience in software product management
* Creating buy-in for our product vision both internally and with key external partners
* Translating product strategy into simplistic, detailed requirements and prototypes
* Co-ordinate information received between emails, WhatsApp voice messages & calls, competitor platforms, stakeholders of all levels and so much more
* Developer’s Time Management
* Ensure Crystal Clarity in sprint tasks
* Test completed sprints
* Drive a Project Management Platform’s usage
* Traffic Light Sprints in order of business value
* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth
* Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact
* Work closely with the engineering team to deliver quick time-to-market by optimizing resources
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding across the business to all stakeholders, internal & external
* Represent the company by talking to customers to solicit feedback on company products and services
* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager
* Well versed with agile software development methodologies
* Some technical background with understanding and/or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies
* Excellent English is very important, written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box and roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
